children: New highway mixed terrain tire delivers consistent and reliable performance for the drivers who drive with purpose, depending on their vehicles every day
AKRON, Ohio, Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Available now, the all-new
Cooper Discoverer® HT

is a highway mixed terrain tire engineered for the people who count on their vehicles every day, from "to do" lists to bucket lists. Specifically designed for drivers of popular trucks and SUVs, Cooper Discoverer HT was created to take on the tasks that enable drivers to take full advantage of their vehicle's potential.

"The toughest jobs aren't always the biggest ones. They're the ones you show up for every day," said Brad Heim, vice president, Product Development Global Consumer, Goodyear. "Constructed for today's truck and SUV owners, the Cooper Discoverer HT combines everyday comfort with dependable highway performance, helping drivers stay confident whether they're pulling a trailer, carrying a heavy load, driving across town or covering hundreds of miles in a single day."
Imagined and built in the U.S., Cooper Discoverer HT is available today in 15 sizes, expanding to 19 by December 2026.
DISCOVERER HT = BUILT TO GO THE DISTANCE

Designed with tall, straight sidewalls and an optimized footprint that places a maximum amount of tread in contact with the road, the Cooper Discoverer HT helps provide confident handling and stability, even when carrying heavy loads.
The mixed terrain Cooper Discoverer HT was engineered to provide long-lasting value without compromising performance. Key benefits include:
70,000-mile / 115,000-km limited treadwear warranty
on Metric sizes and a
55,000-mile / 90,000-km limited treadwear warranty
on LT-Metric sizes.
Durable construction, designed to support hauling, towing, and carrying heavy loads.
Stable handling through an optimized tread footprint and sidewall design.
Enhanced traction throughout the life of the tire through 3D Micro-Gauge™ technology.
Long-wearing tread designed for durability and a quiet ride, even on rough and uneven surfaces.
AVAILABILITY

The all-new Discoverer® HT will be available in 19 popular sizes beginning in October 2026, an additional 16 LT sizes anticipated in the first quarter 2027.  Rim sizes vary from 16 to 22 inches and are available at your local Cooper authorized retailer or on coopertire.com.
PROUDLY MANUFACTURED IN THE U.S.
The Cooper Discoverer HT is proudly manufactured in the United States at three facilities: Texarkana, Arkansas; Findlay, Ohio; and Tupelo, Mississippi.

"The Cooper Discoverer HT reflects more than a century of U.S. manufacturing expertise behind the Cooper brand," said Alain Kohnen, vice president, Global Manufacturing. "This new tire showcases what our teams do best: build high-quality, U.S.-made products that deliver the durability and dependable performance drivers count on every day."
COOPER TIRES REMAIN READY FOR THE ROAD AHEAD
For more than 100 years, Cooper has earned the trust of drivers who demand more from their tires—and themselves.

To celebrate this heritage, Cooper introduced a new brand identity with a look that signals strength, purpose, and confidence – reflecting Cooper's mission to deliver durable, robust tires that tackle jobs of all types, from family highway cruising to towing a boat to mixed- terrain activities.
To extend Cooper's refreshed look beyond the newest tire itself, Cooper-branded merchandise and apparel featuring the new brand identity will be available at
, giving customers, employees and fans another way to show their connection to the brand.
Learn more and purchase at coopertire.com, visit your local Cooper tires authorized retailer or follow @CooperTire on social media.
